channel.title: Namibia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Namibia, every source cited.

item.title: Namibian man claims murder charges are false
item.description: Teodor Shipanga, 49, told the Windhoek High Court he has no knowledge of killing a colleague and stealing N$2.5 million.

item.title: Windhoek to host world autism congress
item.description: The sixth World Autism Organisation Congress will gather international experts and advocates in Namibia's capital from November 3-5.

item.title: FMD costs Namibia N$150 million weekly
item.description: Namibia's livestock industry faces severe disruption as foot-and-mouth disease halts trade and threatens jobs.

item.title: Namibian credit grows by N$5.84 billion in nine months
item.description: Businesses and households borrowed more as rising prices increased the nominal value of loans, but real growth remained flat.

item.title: Andrada Mining's Namibia contribution rises to N$775m
item.description: The company's economic impact grew 6% in the 2026 financial year, driven by wages, royalties, and local procurement.
